question: You should use 'engine brake' to assist you when

options.text: Travelling long distances.
Travelling down a steep slope.
You want to save fuel.

question: When changing gear, the clutch pedal should be depress

options.text: Slowly and released quickly after the change.
Quickly and released quickly after the change.
Quickly and released slowly after the change.

notes: Source typo in question: 'depress' (likely meant 'depressed'); kept as printed.

question: When stopping the vehicle, the engine will stall if

options.text: The clutch pedal is depressed too early.
The clutch pedal is depressed too late.
The brake pedal is over released.

question: When you approach a bend, you should slow down

options.text: As you drive round the bend.
As you leave the bend.
Before you enter the bend.

question: When the engine stalls while moving off on a slope, you should immediately

options.text: Reach for the ignition key and restart the engine.
Step on the brake pedal.
Shift gear lever to neutral position.

question: When you have moved to the right hand side of the road to overtake another vehicle, you should

options.text: Maintain your normal speed and overtake as usual.
Accelerate and overtake as quickly as possible
Decelerate and change to a higher gear.

notes: Option B has no final full stop in the source.

question: While overtaking another vehicle, the vehicle suddenly goes faster, you should

options.text: Accelerate hard to overtake quickly.
Slow down and move safely back to your lane.
Sound the horn continuously to warn the other driver.

question: You are about to reverse into a side road. A pedestrian wishes to cross behind you. You should

options.text: Reverse before the pedestrian starts to cross.
Give way to the pedestrian.
Wave to the pedestrian to stop.

question: You are reversing your vehicle into a side road. When would the greatest hazard be to the passing traffic?

options.text: After you have entered the side road.
When the front of your vehicle swings out.
After you have completed the manoeuvre.

question: When your rear tyre punctures while driving, you should

options.text: Step hard on the brake immediately.
Grip the steering wheel to keep control, apply brake gradually and stop by the side of the road.
Apply both brakes quickly and switch off the engine.

question: Worn out tyres and improper air pressure are other factors that

options.text: Reduce the force of impact.
Reduce the frictional force.
Increase the effect of braking.

question: When negotiating a sharp bend which natural force tends to push your vehicle outwards?

options.text: Gravitational force.
Frictional force.
Centrifugal force.

question: You need a longer distance to stop your vehicle when driving

options.text: On a dry road.
On a wet road.
On a hard and dry ground.

question: When neutral gear is engaged while driving

options.text: The vehicle will negotiate a bend smoothly.
It makes control easier at high speed.
It is very difficult to control the vehicle.

question: When you want to stop your car, you should

options.text: Check the rear and side mirrors, signal and then stop.
Signal first and then stop.
Stop and check the rear and side mirrors.

question: You should dip your headlights when

options.text: Driving in a dark area.
Facing oncoming traffic.
Approaching a blind corner.

question: You see two elderly pedestrians about to cross the road ahead, you should

options.text: Expect them to wait for you to pass.
Speed up to pass them quickly.
Be careful, they may misjudge your speed.

question: When you approach this traffic light junction, you should
picture: Video frame from driver's seat over a blue car bonnet, approaching a junction with green traffic lights

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop when the light changes.
Speed up to pass the junction before the light changes.
Maintain a high speed so as not to disrupt the traffic flow.

notes: Picture panel is a video frame with a Repeat Video button.

question: You are driving towards a zebra crossing. Pedestrians are waiting to cross, you should

options.text: Continue on your way.
Be prepared to stop.
Wave to the people to wait.

question: You are following a lorry approaching a 'U' turn sign. The driver signals right but moves to the left, you should

options.text: Wait behind the lorry.
Overtake on the left-hand side.
Overtake on the right-hand side.
